title: VibeOCR WorkerHost v1 envelope
description: Length-prefixed JSON-RPC envelope for the VibeOCR Named Pipe control channel. Exactly one of three message kinds applies, discriminated by required keys: a request carries 'method'; a response carries 'result' or 'error'; an event carries 'event'. protocol_version is an integer (1) so both Python and C# agree on wire representation and avoid locale-dependent string parsing.

uuid.description: RFC 4122 v4 UUID canonical form (lowercase, dashed).

payload.description: Method-specific JSON object. Schemas live in methods.schema.json. Must be an object (never array/scalar). Large binary data never lives here; use a SharedPayloadRef instead.

request.description: RPC request. Carries a method name and payload.

protocol_version.description: Wire protocol major version. Integer, currently 1.

method.description: Dotted method name, e.g. 'ocr.recognize'. Must be in methods.schema.json allow-list.

deadline_unix_ms.description: Absolute deadline as unix milliseconds. 0 means use server default.

response.description: RPC response. Exactly one of 'result' or 'error' must be present.

result.description: Present iff the request succeeded. Method-specific object.

code.description: Stable error code. Must match errors.json. UI must not parse Python tracebacks.

detail.description: Optional diagnostic detail for logs, never shown to end users verbatim.

retryable.description: Whether the client may retry per design §7 rules.

event.description: Asynchronous server-side event for a task (progress, terminal state).

sequence.description: Monotonic per-task sequence number for ordering. Starts at 0.
